verzen.tekst: My son, don’t deprive the poor of his living.
verzen.html: My son, don’t deprive the poor of his living.

verzen.tekst: Don’t make a hungry soul sorrowful,
verzen.html: Don’t make a hungry soul sorrowful,

verzen.tekst: Don’t add more trouble to a heart that is provoked.
verzen.html: Don’t add more trouble to a heart that is provoked.

verzen.tekst: Don’t reject a suppliant in his affliction.
verzen.html: Don’t reject a suppliant in his affliction.

verzen.tekst: Don’t turn your eye away from one who asks.
verzen.html: Don’t turn your eye away from one who asks.

verzen.tekst: For if he curses you in the bitterness of his soul,
verzen.html: For if he curses you in the bitterness of his soul,

verzen.tekst: Endear yourself to the assembly.
verzen.html: Endear yourself to the assembly.

verzen.tekst: Incline your ear to a poor man.
verzen.html: Incline your ear to a poor man.

verzen.tekst: Deliver him who is wronged from the hand of him who wrongs him;
verzen.html: Deliver him who is wronged from the hand of him who wrongs him;

verzen.tekst: Be as a father to the fatherless,
verzen.html: Be as a father to the fatherless,

verzen.tekst: Wisdom exalts her sons,
verzen.html: Wisdom exalts her sons,

verzen.tekst: He who loves her loves life.
verzen.html: He who loves her loves life.

verzen.tekst: He who holds her fast will inherit glory.
verzen.html: He who holds her fast will inherit glory.

verzen.tekst: Those who serve her minister to the Holy One.
verzen.html: Those who serve her minister to the Holy One.

verzen.tekst: He who listens to her will judge the nations.
verzen.html: He who listens to her will judge the nations.

verzen.tekst: If he trusts her, he will inherit her,
verzen.html: If he trusts her, he will inherit her,

verzen.tekst: For at the first she will walk with him in crooked ways,
verzen.html: For at the first she will walk with him in crooked ways,

verzen.tekst: Then she will return him again to the straight way,
verzen.html: Then she will return him again to the straight way,

verzen.tekst: If he goes astray, she will forsake him,
verzen.html: If he goes astray, she will forsake him,

verzen.tekst: Watch for the opportunity, and beware of evil.
verzen.html: Watch for the opportunity, and beware of evil.

verzen.tekst: For there is a shame that brings sin,
verzen.html: For there is a shame that brings sin,

verzen.tekst: Don’t show partiality, discrediting your soul.
verzen.html: Don’t show partiality, discrediting your soul.

verzen.tekst: Don’t refrain from speaking when it is for safety.
verzen.html: Don’t refrain from speaking when it is for safety.

verzen.tekst: For wisdom will be known by speech,
verzen.html: For wisdom will be known by speech,

verzen.tekst: Don’t speak against the truth
verzen.html: Don’t speak against the truth

verzen.tekst: Don’t be ashamed to confess your sins.
verzen.html: Don’t be ashamed to confess your sins.

verzen.tekst: Don’t lay yourself down for a fool to tread upon.
verzen.html: Don’t lay yourself down for a fool to tread upon.

verzen.tekst: Strive for the truth to death,
verzen.html: Strive for the truth to death,

verzen.tekst: Don’t be hasty with your tongue,
verzen.html: Don’t be hasty with your tongue,

verzen.tekst: Don’t be like a lion in your house,
verzen.html: Don’t be like a lion in your house,

verzen.tekst: Don’t let your hand be stretched out to receive,
verzen.html: Don’t let your hand be stretched out to receive,
